summary: Wait wiggles the fingers of both open hands, palms up, held slightly to one side. It's used for 'hold on' and 'wait a second.'
location: Off to one side at waist height
steps: Hold both hands out to one side, palms up, one a little ahead of the other.
For 'wait a second,' make it small and quick with a slight head tilt.
mistakes: Holding the hands still. The wiggle is the sign.
